# add_percolation_windows_to_fig { #mofography.workflow.add_percolation_windows_to_fig }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Adds internal and PLD-critical window traces onto an existing Plotly figure.

```python
workflow.add_percolation_windows_to_fig(
    fig,
    analysis_result,
    pld_probe_radius=None,
    pld_tolerance=0.25,
)
```

Add window traces (regular + PLD-critical diamonds) to an existing figure.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type   | Description                                                     | Default    |
|------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| fig              |        | plotly Figure (go.Figure)                                       | _required_ |
| analysis_result  |        | dict with 'connections' key from segmentation                   | _required_ |
| pld_probe_radius |        | if given, highlight PLD-critical windows as red diamonds        | `None`     |
| pld_tolerance    |        | radius tolerance for PLD-critical classification (default 0.25) | `0.25`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                     |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------|
|        |        | figure with window traces added |
